lines: Boosted skateboard (160 designs, 113 keep the rider on and the push <= 0.2 g): largest top-speed gain +7.3 m/s over the e-board (18.0 m/s, above the ~13 m/s speed-wobble onset) with 13.7 kg of tank+air, 23 s boost, $3733; best per kg +0.59 m/s/kg.
Staying below 13 m/s the boost adds at most +2.2 m/s (9.2 kg); its real effect is acceleration: 0-10 m/s in 4.5 s vs 5.2 s on wheels alone.

Cold-gas hoverboard (400 designs): longest hover 23.5 s at 597 kg gross (222 kg propellant, $73785); 6-DOF mission (lift-off, hover, 2 m translate, 90 deg turn, land) completed by 5 of 5 simulated Pareto designs.
Cold-gas hoverboard, best hover by gross-mass limit (rider 90.7 kg included): <= 150 kg: 7.2 s; <= 200 kg: 13.1 s; <= 250 kg: 16.9 s.

Rocket hoverboard (400 designs): longest hover 152.0 s at 289 kg gross (133 kg propellant, $27574); 6-DOF mission (lift-off, hover, 2 m translate, 90 deg turn, land) completed by 5 of 5 simulated Pareto designs.
Rocket hoverboard, best hover by gross-mass limit (rider 90.7 kg included): <= 150 kg: 52.2 s; <= 200 kg: 95.8 s; <= 250 kg: 135.0 s.
